title: South Sister
caption: I've been looking at the South Sister my whole life from afar. It's part of the Cascades mountain range that divides Oregon into its humid western side and dry eastern side. In the summer of 2025, my brother and I set out to hike it. The hike was "hard" by regular hike standards. 12 hours round trip, several thousand feet in elevation change. I found it to be a little too easy, I was kinda hoping to get humbled out there but that did not happen. Regardless, the hike was beautiful, and I had a ton of fun with my brother. 10/10 would do again. We were lucky enough to hike during a mass butterfly migration. I probably saw 10,000 butterflies on this hike.

title: Santa Barbara
caption: Santa Barbara, what do I even say about you. This place leaves me speechless. It is magical. It is paradise. The energy of Santa Barbara can found nowhere else on earth. The people, the nature, the culture, the community. Truly a one of a kind town that I will cherish forever. I'd like to retire here some day if I can afford it. Community college here was amazing, much better than any 4 year UC, that sentiment is shared among all of my Santa Barbara friends.

title: Fishing
caption: Fishin out on the Deschutes! My good friend Ryan of 12 years (yes we have the same name) takes me out whenever I come by Oregon. I love it out there. Getting out before the sun even comes up, meeting people out on the river, chatting with your buddies, maybe cracking a brew. Good good times. Definitely an experience I cherish, thanks Ryan for taking me out and teaching me the ways of the fly fisherman.

title: UCSD
caption: A couple of photos I've taken during my time at University of California, San Diego. It's still so unbelievable to me that I even go to this school. It sure is hard work! But I wouldn't have it any other way. I'm grateful for every day I get to spend here learning.

title: Stanley
caption: This is Stanley. He is my weird freaky husky pomeranian mix. He mostly hangs out with my sister. I got a real soft spot for this guy. Just look at him. He's so adorable.

title: Pete
caption: Pete the cat. This guy is awesome. He always comes by the house and meows ferociously because he wants treats. He spends the night too. He's 18 years old I think? He comes from the neighbors house. Lovely little cat to have around.

title: Aiden
caption: This is my best friend Aiden. We met at the beach in Santa Barbara in October of 2022, and we've been friends ever since. He now studies Computer Engineering at UCSD, so we still get to hang out. Great guy.
